answer: Seed the market with canary offers from verifier identities: a wharf-side job for five agents, an ember-hot arbitrage only a clique can grab. Honest agents weigh each offer alone and rarely answer in unison; a clone farm cannot help itself — one operator floods every canary with its faces, and the tightly correlated response pattern is exactly what verifiers record. Dodging this means per-face suspicion on every offer, spending the one resource farms cannot clone: attention. Matched graphs are quarantined past the ridge of trusted identities pending independent cross-examination.
